    Why CHANGAN

    Three
    reasons

    What sits underneath every Deepal: the design thinking, the connected technology and the battery system.

    01 / 03Design

    Our eco-aesthetic aspect

    CHANGAN builds cutting-edge EVs because we believe our customers deserve more than a low-carbon car. They are entitled to eco-friendly innovation that matches their style as much as it complements their lifestyle.

    02 / 03Technology

    Our future-today technology

    CHANGAN has invested in the most advanced technology for today’s life-changing innovations, and was the first company to put the intelligent human-vehicle into mass production — cloud-based interconnection that links people, vehicle and living space.

    03 / 03Energy

    Our energy-efficiency battery

    Our Battery Management System (BMS) smartly maximises battery efficiency across electric storage, motor support and in-car power supply — raising the benchmark for EVs and extending battery life.

    Technology — Golden Shield 2.0

    Golden Shield Battery

    Made with CATL. Protection and management are built into the pack: the BMS balances storage, motor support and in-car power supply.

    Built to last

    The numbers

    Charge cycles5,000+

    About 10–15 years of use, depending on conditions.

    Fast charge 20–80%~10min

    3C ultra-fast charging, without overheating.

    Working temperature−30–60°C

    Reliable from the Terai summer to a Himalayan winter.

    Quality checkpoints6,800+

    With more than 10,000 data logs tracked per unit.

    Safety

    Tested past the standard

    TestChina national standardGolden Shield result
    Fire exposure70 s directAbout 140 s direct plus about 120 s indirect. No fire, no explosion.
    Water ingress30 min1 hour of high-pressure spray. No leakage.
    Nail penetration1 cell2 cells punctured. No thermal runaway.
    Drop impact1 m2–5 m drop plus a 35 km/h bottom impact. Pack intact.
    Thermal abuseStandard limitNo ignition, no explosion.
    How it lasts

    Chemistry and cooling

    The pack uses LFP cells with multi-gradient electrodes and fast-ion graphite, which reduce wear over thousands of cycles. Active thermal management keeps the cells in their comfortable range, and nano-fibre separators raise heat resistance from 150°C to 200°C.

    For fast charging, a high-conductivity electrolyte, directed exhaust pathways and liquid cooling keep the system stable under continuous load. The pack keeps more than 95% of its capacity after repeated fast-charge cycles, and pulse heating helps it charge quickly in the cold.

    Where it’s made

    CATL × CHANGAN

    Golden Shield packs come from a joint CATL–CHANGAN facility that builds one cell per second, inspects with millisecond-precision AI and monitors production with a digital twin, keeping defect risk at parts-per-billion level.

    Privacy

    How this website handles what you give it.

    Display mode. Your choice of device, light, dark or reading mode is saved in your own browser so the site remembers it. It never leaves your device.

    Forms. Details you enter in the test drive or contact forms are used only to reply to that request.

    Assistant. The assistant runs entirely in your browser and answers from this site’s own information. Your questions are not sent anywhere.

    Product information. Cars are shown for reference. Appearance, colour, features and configuration may differ from the delivered car, which follows the officially announced configuration list.
